basic_info.description: Charming and affordable opportunity in the sought-after Sunset District! 3043 Noriega Street offers a cute and inviting 3BD/2BA home with garage parking and bonus outdoor space. The home features an updated kitchen and baths, including a serene Japanese-style bathroom that brings a spa-like retreat into your everyday routine. Fresh curb appeal, views of the ocean sparkle and a smart layout make this property ideal for first-time buyers or investors alike. Enjoy being just minutes to Ocean Beach, Golden Gate Park, Stern Grove, and the Noriega Street corridor filled with local cafes, markets, and restaurants. Easy Muni and freeway access. A perfect chance to get your foot into the Sunset!
